name: Onnagokoro to Fuyu no Kaze
source:
Chosen by the holy sword, Laos accepted his charge and went on a six-month quest to slay the demon lord. He returned victorious, but something about his beloved princess had... changed. What happened these last six months? At her request, and to put his doubts to rest, he visited her night quarters.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096762.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
被圣剑选中后，拉奥斯接受使命，踏上长达半年的讨伐魔王之旅。他凯旋而归，却发现心爱的公主似乎…变了。这半年里究竟发生了什么？应公主的邀请，也为消除心中的疑虑，他在夜里走进了她的寝宫。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096762.html]DLsite英语版[/url]]
